tools.name: bannerbear_get_account
tools.description: Get account details and usage: api_usage, api_quota, and paid_plan_name. API: GET /v2/account.

tools.name: bannerbear_list_templates
tools.description: List the templates in the project. Filter/paginate with page, tag, name, and limit. API: GET /v2/templates.

tools.name: bannerbear_get_template
tools.description: Get a single template incl. its available_modifications (the layers you can override when generating). API: GET /v2/templates/{uid}.

tools.name: bannerbear_list_template_sets
tools.description: List the template sets in the project (used by collections). API: GET /v2/template_sets.

tools.name: bannerbear_get_template_set
tools.description: Get a single template set and the templates it contains. API: GET /v2/template_sets/{uid}.

tools.name: bannerbear_list_images
tools.description: List generated images in the project (paginated). API: GET /v2/images.

tools.name: bannerbear_get_image
tools.description: Get a single generated image — poll this to check an async render (status: pending | completed | failed; image_url populates on completion). API: GET /v2/images/{uid}.

tools.name: bannerbear_get_video
tools.description: Get a single generated video — poll this to check an async render (status: pending | completed | failed; video_url populates on completion). API: GET /v2/videos/{uid}.

tools.name: bannerbear_get_collection
tools.description: Get a single collection — poll this to check an async render (status: pending | completed | failed; image_urls map populates on completion). API: GET /v2/collections/{uid}.

tools.name: bannerbear_list_fonts
tools.description: List the fonts available for use in template modifications. API: GET /v2/fonts.

tools.name: bannerbear_list_effects
tools.description: List the image effects available for use in template modifications. API: GET /v2/effects.

tools.name: bannerbear_create_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a template (additive; CONSUMES API quota). Async by default: returns a `pending` image whose uid you poll with bannerbear_get_image. Set synchronous:true to block and receive the finished image (image_url populated) via the sync host. API: POST /v2/images.

tools.name: bannerbear_create_collection
tools.description: Generate a collection of images from a template set (additive; CONSUMES API quota). Async: returns a `pending` collection whose uid you poll with bannerbear_get_collection (image_urls map populates on completion). API: POST /v2/collections.

tools.name: bannerbear_create_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a web page (additive; CONSUMES API quota). Async by default: returns a `pending` screenshot to poll. Set synchronous:true to block and receive the finished screenshot via the sync host. API: POST /v2/screenshots.

tools.name: bannerbear_create_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a video template (additive; CONSUMES API quota). Async: returns a `pending` video whose uid you poll with bannerbear_get_video (video_url populates on completion). API: POST /v2/videos.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bannerbear_create_image, bannerbear_create_screenshot · Public sink: bannerbear_create_image, bannerbear_create_collection, bannerbear_create_screenshot, bannerbear_create_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bannerbear_create_image, bannerbear_create_screenshot · Public sink: bannerbear_create_image, bannerbear_create_collection, bannerbear_create_screenshot, bannerbear_create_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
